description: Open-source cross-modal and multimodal prompt injection test suite. 250,000+ attack payloads across text, image, document, and audio modalities. Research-backed by OWASP LLM Top 10, CrossInject (ACM MM 2025), FigStep (AAAI 2025), DolphinAttack, and CSA 2026.
